result:
Perfect! **All tests pass.** 

The bug was on line 24 of `invoicing/money.py`. The condition `while len(head) > 3:` should have been `while len(head) > 2:`. 

In Indian digit grouping, the pattern is: last 3 digits form a group, then groups of 2 from right to left. The original code only extracted 2-digit groups when there were *more than* 3 digits remaining, but it should extract when there are *more than* 2 digits. This meant that a head with exactly 3 digits (like "123" from 123456 rupees) never got split into "1" and "23".

The fix now correctly formats 12345678 paise as "₹1,23,456.78" instead of "₹123,456.78".
